items.detail: ssh binary discovery, argv quoting and exit-code mapping are proven on macOS only. Windows OpenSSH (ssh.exe, path discovery, argv rules, stderr shapes) requires native qualification.
items.title: Windows OpenSSH availability/behavior qualification

items.detail: ssh-agent and identity-file resolution behaviors on Windows are unqualified.
items.title: Windows credential/agent integration

items.detail: No disposable SSH test target was available on the proof host; live network transport is covered by deterministic hermetic proofs only. A live round trip (both macOS->Linux and Windows) remains to be qualified.
items.title: Real remote-host round trip

items.detail: Certificate auth reference exists in the domain, but enterprise CA principals, principals= restrictions and KRLs are unqualified.
items.title: Enterprise SSH certificates/CA environments

items.detail: Inventory is conservatively capped at 256 hosts and concurrency at 16. Soak and scale qualification beyond lab sizes is deferred.
items.title: Large-fleet scale/soak qualification

items.detail: Scheduling semantics are proven deterministically on macOS; a continuously running Windows scheduler service requires native qualification.
items.title: Continuous background scheduling on Windows

items.detail: Phase 34 is read-only by design. Any future remote mutation path requires its own adversarial phase with consent and rollback architecture.
items.title: Remote remediation deliberately deferred
